title: Time-blocked MCSA benchmark for progressively drilled rotor-bar faults: data, firmware and code
description: Raw motor-current recordings (healthy and one, two and three partially drilled rotor bars), STM32/ADC acquisition sketch, window and split manifests, extracted features, analysis code and results supporting a time-blocked machine-learning benchmark of rotor-bar fault classification.
